mapper.select: SELECT g.game_id, g.game_code, g.game_name, g.category, gp.provider_code, g.thumbnail_url, g.play_count, g.enabled, g.create_time FROM t_game g JOIN t_game_provider gp ON g.provider_id = gp.provider_id WHERE g.deleted = FALSE AND g.enabled = TRUE AND gp.deleted = FALSE AND gp.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY g.play_count DESC

SELECT g.game_id, g.game_code, g.game_name, g.category, gp.provider_code, g.thumbnail_url, g.play_count, g.enabled, g.create_time FROM t_game g JOIN t_game_provider gp ON g.provider_id = gp.provider_id WHERE g.deleted = FALSE AND g.enabled = TRUE AND gp.deleted = FALSE AND gp.enabled = TRUE AND g.category = #{category} ORDER BY g.play_count DESC
